tablet.notes: When you swipe between Chats, Groups, Calls, Contacts and Voicemail, the top row (title, search, the A, refresh, settings) now stays still, like WhatsApp: only what is under it slides, and the next screen's own top row appears when it opens. The Call info pop-up has a Call history button. Also: no red unread dots on Chats and Groups, a round back-to-top arrow on Contacts, one-tap Quick replies buttons on calls and the contact card, and Call history in a chat's Info screen.

tablet-regular.notes:
Hold a message: the whole screen goes soft, emoji reactions sit above it and a card of actions below (Forward, Copy, Delete, Select more, Info), like Google Messages. Select more and the Details page match too.
The keyboard closes after you send and when you swipe through the messages. The voice recorder is much smaller. The tablet icon on messages another tablet sent no longer goes missing.
Fixed a crash when opening a video that had been downloaded ahead.
Since the last update: bubbles stop at about three quarters of the width.

messageplus.notes: New "Back to conversations" button: inside a conversation, press the microphone key (under the right soft key) to go back to all your conversations. What you typed stays as a draft. You can also use the Send key or the Camera key: choose in Settings > Home Screen Shortcut, at the bottom, or on the tablet.

messageplus_previous.notes:
Leaving a chat now works like the regular Verizon Messages: press End or Home while a conversation is open, and the next time you open Message+ it shows all your conversations. What you typed stays as a draft.
New: on the tablet, Settings > Flip phone buttons has two choices for each button. The new one goes back to all conversations from inside a conversation.

tablet2.notes:
Fixes messages showing twice after the phone's history sync, and makes opening the app with a large message history much faster (the cleanup of those copies no longer scans every message again and again).
Also in this copy: the Performance log (Settings > Performance log), and group texts from a new group start their own group.
